Fiscal year data are mapped to calendar year as follows: FY(t-1/t) = CY(t). Prior to 1996, the data are in fiscal year (FY) reporting basis converted to calendar year by averaging two FYs (e.g. 1990 is the average of 1989/90 and 1990/91), and are further adjusted to produce a smooth series with the use of a splicing technique. These estimates continue to serve as proxies for historical series when complete information is unavailable. Base for CPI: September 2021=100. Historical data source: National Reserve Bank of Tonga.

interpretation_limits: This utility validates and summarizes the supplied comparison artifact; it does not retrieve original source records or source revision histories.
A persistent discrepancy is a review priority, not proof that either provider is wrong.
IMF actual status is only the comparison's hint from LATEST_ACTUAL_ANNUAL_DATA; WDI status is not classified.
A same-numbered year may not represent the same reporting period; fiscal-year metadata is preserved but not shifted.
Relative differences are unstable when the WDI denominator is close to zero; inspect absolute differences and source values as well.
The live WDI API comparison is not vintage-aligned with the fixed IMF October 2026 export.
No source policy, approval, release, or canonical database action is performed.
